goals: Provide a standalone Stone-like mossy_stone:mossy_stone family for Minecraft Java 26.2 without a Regions Unexplored compile or runtime dependency.
Own the full block, slab, stairs, and wall while leaving derived Vertical Slab and Step geometry and recipe ownership exclusively with Block Geometry Extensions.
Preserve the approved Mossy Stone texture, full-block degradation loot, owned-shape self-drops, and exact acquisition, crafting, and stonecutting behavior from Canary 2.
scope: Maintain exact Canary 2 source, build, resources, and focused tests from legacy implementation commit 2008a418d868139e88bc066672d10f8463d84e0f and frozen checkpoint f0101f38c446dddaa4226450386402c63597ba7c.

Maintain the standalone canonical parent plus directly owned slab, stairs, and wall with vanilla Stone property baselines, the own-namespace ShapeMap contribution, four loot tables, and eleven recipes with their matching unlock advancements.
Retain exact Canary 2 as the current runtime-untested candidate and exact Canary 1 as its never-deployed historical predecessor without representing either release as accepted or rollback.

exclusions: No implementation, version, recipe, loot, registration, asset, geometry, or gameplay change beyond the exact frozen Canary 2 migration.
No direct Vertical Slab or Step registration or recipe ownership and no duplicate or competing Block Geometry Extensions material-family system.
No Regions Unexplored code, registry, model, data, world generation, compile dependency, or runtime dependency; only the approved texture and its unchanged MIT provenance notice are retained.
No changes to Block Geometry Extensions, Nibaru, Interchangeable Block Families, another project, shared infrastructure, or Test Instance Manager state.
No deployment, Test Slot mutation, Minecraft instance access, runtime testing, acceptance, or runtime inference during this migration.
